content: Excel's recognition of ISO 8601 yyyy-mm-dd strings in CSV on open is version/locale inconsistent: some versions convert to real date cells, others keep text (community reports: 'Excel recognises anything as a date, except ISO8601'). Either way chronological sorting holds — a real date sorts chronologically, and ISO text sorts lexicographically = chronologically. CSV is plain text; interpretation depends on the opening app's locale (Accusoft FAQ). Phase D-06 decision (ISO dates) is behaviorally safe under both outcomes.
